somali: Inaad soo daahdo way ka fiican tahay inaadan imaan.
meaning: It is better to do something late than not do it at all.
explanation: Use this when someone finally does something, even after the expected time.
example_english: You finished the form after the deadline, but better late than never.
example_somali: Foomka waad dhamaysay waqtigii ka dib, laakiin inaad soo daahdo way ka fiican tahay inaadan samayn.

meaning: Something is very easy.
explanation: Use this in casual speech when a task was simple.
example_english: The listening exercise was a piece of cake today.
example_somali: Layliga dhageysiga maanta aad buu u fududaa.

somali: Bilow hadal si dadka u nafisaan.
meaning: To make people feel more comfortable at the beginning of a conversation.
explanation: Use this when someone starts a friendly conversation in an awkward or quiet situation.
example_english: The teacher asked a simple question to break the ice.
example_somali: Macallinku su'aal fudud ayuu weydiiyay si dadka u nafisaan.

meaning: Feeling a little sick.
explanation: Use this when someone is not seriously ill but does not feel well.
example_english: I am a little under the weather, so I will rest today.
example_somali: Waxaan dareemayaa caafimaad darro yar, markaa maanta waan nasanayaa.

meaning: To leave or start a journey.
explanation: Use this casually when it is time to go somewhere.
example_english: It is getting late; we should hit the road.
example_somali: Waqtigu wuu sii daahayaa; waa inaan safarka bilownaa.

meaning: Very rarely.
explanation: Use this to describe something that almost never happens.
example_english: I eat at that restaurant once in a blue moon.
example_somali: Makhaayaddaas marar aad u dhif ah ayaan ka cunteeyaa.

english: Cost an arm and a leg.
meaning: To be very expensive.
explanation: Use this casually when something costs much more than expected.
example_english: The taxi to the airport cost an arm and a leg.
example_somali: Taksigii garoonka diyaaradaha aad buu qaali u ahaa.

meaning: To watch or look after someone or something.
explanation: Use this when asking someone to pay attention to something for safety or care.
example_english: Please keep an eye on my bag while I buy the tickets.
example_somali: Fadlan boorsadayda isha ku hay inta aan tigidhada iibsanayo.

meaning: To understand and agree about the same thing.
explanation: Use this when people have the same understanding of a plan or decision.
example_english: Before we send the message, let's make sure we are on the same page.
example_somali: Ka hor inta aan farriinta dirin, aan hubinno inaan isku faham nahay.

meaning: To stop working for the day.
explanation: Use this when enough work has been done and it is time to stop.
example_english: We finished the report, so let's call it a day.
example_somali: Warbixintii waan dhamaynay, markaa aan shaqada maanta joojinno.

meaning: There is no need to hurry.
explanation: Use this to make someone feel relaxed about time.
example_english: No rush, you can send the email after lunch.
example_somali: Degdeg ma jiro, iimaylka qadada ka dib ayaad diri kartaa.

somali: Ilaa hadda wax walba way fiican yihiin.
meaning: Things are going well up to this point.
explanation: Use this when progress is good but the situation is not finished yet.
example_english: The move is not finished, but so far, so good.
example_somali: Guuritaanku weli ma dhammaan, laakiin ilaa hadda wax walba way fiican yihiin.

meaning: Used before giving a short version of a longer story.
explanation: Use this when you do not want to explain every detail.
example_english: A long story short, I missed the bus and arrived late.
example_somali: Sheekada oo kooban, baskii waan seegay oo waan soo daahay.

meaning: Just before the final possible time.
explanation: Use this when something happens very close to a deadline or event.
example_english: They changed the meeting room at the last minute.
example_somali: Waxay qolka shirka beddeleen daqiiqaddii ugu dambeysay.

meaning: Over a long period of time.
explanation: Use this when talking about future results, not immediate results.
example_english: Studying a little every day helps in the long run.
example_somali: Maalin kasta wax yar oo la barto mustaqbalka fog way caawisaa.

meaning: Do something slowly and carefully, step by step.
explanation: Use this to encourage someone who feels overwhelmed.
example_english: The form looks difficult, but take it one step at a time.
example_somali: Foomku wuu u muuqdaa adag, laakiin hal tallaabo mar kasta u samee.

somali: Inta ka dhakhso badan, way ka fiican tahay.
meaning: It is better to do something as soon as possible.
explanation: Use this when delay could cause a problem.
example_english: You should book the appointment today; the sooner, the better.
example_somali: Maanta waa inaad ballanta qabsataa; inta ka dhakhso badan, way ka fiican tahay.

somali: Is deji oo si fudud u qaado.
meaning: Relax or do not work too hard.
explanation: Use this when someone needs rest or should not worry too much.
example_english: You still feel weak, so take it easy today.
example_somali: Weli tabar-darro ayaad dareemaysaa, markaa maanta is deji.

meaning: I forgot it.
explanation: Use this when you forgot something unintentionally.
example_english: I meant to bring the receipt, but it slipped my mind.
example_somali: Waxaan rabay inaan rasiidka keeno, laakiin waan illoobay.

meaning: I did not notice how much time had passed.
explanation: Use this when you are late because you were focused on something else.
example_english: I was studying and lost track of time.
example_somali: Waxaan ku mashquulsanaa waxbarasho, waqtigiina waan ilaaway.

meaning: Try doing something.
explanation: Use this to encourage someone to attempt something.
example_english: The sentence is difficult, but give it a try.
example_somali: Weedhu way adag tahay, laakiin isku day.

meaning: It is not a serious problem.
explanation: Use this to reassure someone after a small mistake.
example_english: You forgot one word; no big deal.
example_somali: Hal eray ayaad illowday; arrin weyn ma aha.

meaning: What someone said is reasonable or acceptable.
explanation: Use this when you accept someone's reason, even if it was not your first choice.
example_english: You cannot come because you are working? Fair enough.
example_somali: Ma iman kartid sababtoo ah waad shaqaynaysaa? Taasi waa macquul.

meaning: Everything is ready or finished.
explanation: Use this when preparations are complete.
example_english: The bags are in the car, and we are all set.
example_somali: Boorsooyinku gaariga ayay ku jiraan, wax walbana waa diyaar.

meaning: Immediately.
explanation: Use this when something will happen now or very soon.
example_english: I will send the address right away.
example_somali: Cinwaanka isla markiiba ayaan diri doonaa.

meaning: For the present time, but possibly not later.
explanation: Use this when a decision or situation is temporary.
example_english: Use this phone number for now.
example_somali: Hadda kaliya isticmaal lambarkan telefoonka.

meaning: To be prepared for a possible situation.
explanation: Use this when doing something as a precaution.
example_english: Bring your ID just in case they ask for it.
example_somali: Aqoonsigaaga keen haddii loo baahdo inay ku weydiiyaan.

meaning: Physically present, not by phone or online.
explanation: Use this when someone must go somewhere themselves.
example_english: You need to sign the contract in person.
example_somali: Waa inaad heshiiska si fool ka fool ah u saxiixdaa.

meaning: Written down, not only spoken.
explanation: Use this when information or permission must be written.
example_english: Please give me the appointment time in writing.
example_somali: Fadlan waqtiga ballanta qoraal ahaan ii sii.

meaning: Accidentally, not intentionally.
explanation: Use this when something happened without meaning to do it.
example_english: I took the wrong bag by mistake.
example_somali: Boorsada khaldan ayaan si qalad ah u qaatay.

meaning: A machine or facility is broken and cannot be used.
explanation: Use this for elevators, bathrooms, machines, or ticket machines.
example_english: The elevator is out of order today.
example_somali: Wiishku maanta ma shaqaynayo.

meaning: A shop has no more of an item to sell.
explanation: Use this when a product is temporarily unavailable.
example_english: The small size is out of stock.
example_somali: Cabbirka yar alaabtiisii way dhammaatay.

meaning: You can decide.
explanation: Use this when the choice belongs to another person.
example_english: We can meet at home or at the cafe; it is up to you.
example_somali: Guriga ama kafeega ayaan ku kulmi karnaa; adiga ayay kuu taallaa.

meaning: Working properly after being started or fixed.
explanation: Use this for technology, services, or systems.
example_english: The internet is up and running again.
example_somali: Internetku mar kale wuu shaqaynayaa oo diyaar yahay.

meaning: One stage at a time.
explanation: Use this when explaining a process slowly and clearly.
example_english: Show me how to log in step by step.
example_somali: Tallaabo tallaabo ii tus sida loo galo.

meaning: Starting from the beginning with nothing already prepared.
explanation: Use this when something begins completely new.
example_english: I am learning English from scratch.
example_somali: Ingiriisi meel eber ah ayaan ka baranayaa.

meaning: Before the time something happens.
explanation: Use this when talking about preparing, booking, or paying early.
example_english: You should book the room in advance.
example_somali: Qolka waa inaad hore u qabsataa.

meaning: Earlier than required.
explanation: Use this when something is done before a deadline or appointment.
example_english: Please arrive ahead of time for the interview.
example_somali: Fadlan wareysiga u imow waqtiga ka hor.

meaning: At the correct or expected time.
explanation: Use this when someone is not late.
example_english: The bus arrived on time this morning.
example_somali: Basku subaxdan waqtiga saxda ah ayuu yimid.

meaning: To be later than planned.
explanation: Use this when someone or something is delayed.
example_english: I am running late because of traffic.
example_somali: Taraafikada awgeed waan soo daahayaa.

meaning: To decide.
explanation: Use this when someone needs to choose between options.
example_english: Take a minute and make up your mind about the size.
example_somali: Daqiiqad qaado oo cabbirka go'aan ka gaar.

meaning: Continue communicating with someone.
explanation: Use this when saying goodbye to someone you want to contact again.
example_english: It was nice to meet you; let's keep in touch.
example_somali: Waan ku farxay inaan kula kulmo; xiriirka aan sii wadno.

meaning: Contact someone.
explanation: Use this when asking or telling someone to contact another person.
example_english: Get in touch with the office if your address changes.
example_somali: La soo xiriir xafiiska haddii cinwaankaagu is beddelo.

meaning: Check so that something is certain.
explanation: Use this when confirming an important detail.
example_english: Make sure the door is locked before you leave.
example_somali: Hubi in albaabku xiran yahay ka hor intaadan bixin.

meaning: Do not make something complicated.
explanation: Use this when simple words, plans, or steps are better.
example_english: When you explain the problem, keep it simple.
example_somali: Markaad dhibaatada sharxayso, ka dhig mid fudud.
